requirements.text: Personalised timetable management should allow students to color-code classes, hide cancelled ones, and add study blocks.
Automated grade notifications should inform students when grades are posted.
Deadline notifications should remind students of assignment due dates and exam schedules.
A structured module feedback system should enable students to provide feedback on content quality, delivery, and resources while ensuring anonymity.
All enhancements must fit within the current portal infrastructure without causing major changes.
Stability must be maintained throughout the implementation of new features.
